title: 第739章 麒麟族等于土木族第738章 开天之劫化身盘古
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：西游：开局获得太白金星传承第一卷：默认第739章麒麟族等于土木族（..la）就这样，随着开天之劫的结束，这方世界也已经完全成型。
伏羲回过神后，连忙迎了过去。
此刻，叶云也散去神通，气息归于平静，身形恢复如常。
他看向伏羲，笑道：“前辈，开天已完成，可还满意。”
伏羲笑容满面，连连点头，眸中尽是感激。
“满意，太满意了，这次全靠你了，不然的话，这世界即便开辟出来了，那开天之劫我也无法应对。”
毕竟那么多混沌魔神的虚影，即便强如伏羲，也不敢保证能对付。
而若是失败，显然是亏大了，这些年的心血都白费了。
当然，有女娲在，倒不至于白费，但一旦请女娲出山，意味着他要去给这位妹妹打工十个元会。
端茶倒水，捶背捏肩，种花养草，洗衣做饭。
这对伏羲来说，更是难以忍受了。
“那丫头，太能折腾人了。”
“还是虎儿靠谱，一次搞定，不拖泥带水。”
说着，伏羲看向眼前开辟的世界，眸中闪过一丝期待。
“接下来便是去请麒麟族去建设这方世界，稳固山川，调理灵气，梳理生机，完成后，就能迁移人族入住了。”
叶云闻言，有些惊讶：“麒麟族？”
伏羲点了点头，捋须而笑。
“麒麟族自从三族大劫，元气大伤后，便开展了新的发展途径。”
“即替那些刚刚开辟的世界建设，稳固山川，调理灵气，梳理生机，布置阵法，种植灵根。”
“简而言之，就是专业的世界建造团队。”
叶云听到这话，嘴角抽搐，眼皮狂跳。
麒麟族这是干起了前世土木老哥们的活吗？
搬砖砌墙，打灰浇筑，测量放线，验收整改。
所以，麒麟族就相当于土木族？
不过仔细想想也不意外。
毕竟麒麟乃是祥瑞，脚踏祥云。
族内又有五行麒麟，金木水火土俱全，简直就是完美的土木建造好手。
地脉梳理，山川稳固，灵气调理，生机汇聚。
无一不精，无一不通，无一不晓。
只能说，让麒麟族发展此业务的家伙，是个天才。
“这业务拓展，属实没想到。”
“麒麟族，洪荒第一建筑队。”
“以后开辟世界，还得找他们装修。”
叶云心中暗语，差点笑出声。
之后，又聊了一会儿，伏羲便离开去找麒麟族了。
而叶云则回到了天庭总部，继续爆肝他的三大法门。
进度缓慢，但稳步提升。
叶云眸光深邃，望向虚空深处。
“继续肝，早日圆满，晋升半步混元大罗金仙。”
密室之内，归于沉寂。
唯有那无形的进度，在缓缓增长。
寰宇万界，一条时间线的时空之中。
有一道身影无声无息的来此。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Journey to the West: Obtaining the Taibaijin Star Heritage at the Beginning Volume 1: Default Chapter 739 The Qilin Clan is equal to the Tumu Clan (..la) In this way, with the end of the Tribulation of the Opening of the Sky, this world has been fully formed.
After Fuxi came to his senses, he hurriedly greeted him.
At this moment, Ye Yun also dissipated his magical power, his breath became calm, and his body returned to normal.
He looked at Fuxi and said with a smile: "Senior, the creation of the sky has been completed, but I am still satisfied."
Fuxi smiled broadly and nodded repeatedly, his eyes filled with gratitude.
"Satisfied, so satisfied. It all depends on you this time. Otherwise, even if this world is opened up, I won't be able to cope with the catastrophe of the opening of the sky."
After all, there are so many phantoms of the Chaos Demon God, even if they are as powerful as Fuxi, there is no guarantee that they can be dealt with.
And if it fails, it will obviously be a big loss, and all the hard work over the years will be in vain.
Of course, with Nuwa here, it would not be in vain, but once Nuwa is asked to come out, it means that he has to work for this sister for ten yuan.
Bringing tea and water, rubbing backs and shoulders, planting flowers and grass, doing laundry and cooking.
This was even more unbearable for Fuxi.
"That girl is so annoying."
"Hu'er is still reliable. He can get it done in one go without any sloppiness."
As he spoke, Fuxi looked at the world that opened up in front of him, a trace of anticipation flashing in his eyes.
"The next step is to ask the Qilin tribe to build this world, stabilize the mountains and rivers, adjust the spiritual energy, and sort out the vitality. Once completed, the human tribe can move in."
Ye Yun was a little surprised when he heard this: "Qilin tribe?"
Fuxi nodded, stroking his beard and smiling.
"The Qilin tribe has embarked on a new development path since the catastrophe of the three tribes and their vitality was severely damaged."
"That is to build the world that has just been opened up, stabilize the mountains and rivers, regulate the spiritual energy, sort out the vitality, arrange the formations, and plant the spiritual roots."
"In short, a professional world-building team."
When Ye Yun heard this, the corners of his mouth twitched and his eyelids twitched wildly.
Are the Qilin tribe doing the work of their old civil engineering buddies in their previous lives?
Moving bricks and laying walls, plastering and pouring, measuring and laying out lines, acceptance and rectification.
So, the Qilin tribe is equivalent to the Tumu tribe?
But it’s not surprising if you think about it carefully.
After all, Qilin is auspicious and has auspicious clouds under its feet.
There is also a five-element Qilin in the clan, with metal, wood, water, fire and earth, making him a perfect civil construction expert.
The earth's veins are combed, the mountains and rivers are stabilized, the aura is regulated, and the vitality is gathered.
Nothing is masterful, nothing is ignorant, nothing is unknown.
It can only be said that the guy who asked the Qilin tribe to develop this business is a genius.
“This business expansion is truly unexpected.”
"The Qilin tribe, the first construction team in the prehistoric times."
"When we open up the world in the future, we have to find them to decorate it."
Ye Yun secretly whispered in his heart and almost laughed out loud.
Afterwards, after chatting for a while, Fuxi left to find the Qilin tribe.
Ye Yun returned to Tianting headquarters and continued to use his three major methods.
Progress is slow but steady.
Ye Yun's eyes were deep, looking into the depths of the void.
"Keep up the liver, achieve consummation as soon as possible, and be promoted to half-step Hunyuan Da Luo Jinxian."
Within the secret room, silence fell.
Only the invisible progress is slowly increasing.
…
All over the world, in the time and space of a timeline.
A figure came here silently.
